title: Tesla's wireless power and claimed over-unity

tellings.quote: and frankly uh there's are accounts that suggest that or not suggest that state that that Tesla believed that he was even able to achieve so-called overunity.

plain: A former US Senate staffer, Kurt McConnell, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2025 that, alongside his work on sending electricity without wires, the inventor Nikola Tesla believed, according to some accounts, that he had reached over-unity, meaning a machine that gives out more energy than is put in. If true, it would mean a source of nearly free power was found over a century ago.
